info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Drivers-v4-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Driver Listing API provides access to the details of drivers participating in the rideshare service. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve a comprehensive list of registered rideshare drivers, enabling applications to showcase service availability, driver profiles, and performance metrics. Typical users of this API include mobile app developers, rideshare platform administrators, and data analysts who need insights into driver engagement. Users can leverage this information for operational analysis, enhancing user experience, and optimizing driver allocations.

get.summary: Retrieve rides associated with a specific driver.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all the rides assigned to a particular driver, providing insights into their work history and statistics.
